Agent-assisted editing: asynchronous producers, same mutation boundary
|
|-- Browser page: PromptComposerCoordinator
|   |-- Entries, editable drafts, exact captured requests, polling timers
|   |-- submit() -> client.capture(): expectedVersion + baseRevisionId
|   |   `-- client.start() -> backend; status() / cancel(); retry exact request
|   `-- Lifetime independent of selection, panel visibility and undo
|-- Backend: AgentDiagrammingSessionService
|   `-- DiagramEditService
|       |-- Runs + request-ID deduplication + abort controllers
|       |-- Captured canvas + pinned references + AgentContext -> generator
|       |-- Retained generated revision -> install; retry does not regenerate
|       `-- DiagramEditCanvasPort.apply()/create() -> bridge.dispatch()
|-- Browser page: useAgentCanvasBridge
|   |-- Register ephemeral canvas, poll commands, invoke page handler, reply
|   |-- apply-diagram-revision / apply-diagram-batch -> revision receiver
|   `-- Cleanup: abort polling and unregister canvas instance
`-- Browser page: DiagramRevisionReceiver
    |-- Receipts keyed by documentId + requestId; reject changed payload
    |-- apply()/batch() -> controller.applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations)
    |   `-- Base revision guard; generated revisions/creations become operations
    |-- Retain receipt immediately after mutation, BEFORE persistence
    `-- Persist callback: WorkspacePersistence.sync(ids) + WorkspaceStorage.flush()
        `-- Acknowledge only after success; failed flush -> PERSISTENCE_PENDING
